fitCaveat: Program codes are research-fit inferences from official fields, never course equivalences. Institutional access does not prove AUI nomination, open seats, graduate course availability, funding or approval for the planned semester.

formatNotes: All 186 existing constraints values are arrays of strings; no non-string array items found.
eligibility and constraints currently duplicate the same base facts. Rendering both creates duplicate text; combine and deduplicate before display.
Graduate-specific conditions are string arrays, not objects. Use supportedStudyLevels for structured matching and graduateConstraints for explanatory copy.
levelRestriction:null means the source does not impose a listed restriction; it does not prove graduate access.
Concordia maxHostCredits:15 is undergraduate-only; use hostCreditsByLevel instead.
Document sources use doc and paragraph, not url/page. Do not construct broken links or invent document page numbers.
minimumGpa:null means unverified, not zero or automatically satisfied.
Preserve PEL vs Bilateral. A university offering graduate fee-paying study is not proof of a tuition-waived exchange seat.
